rows.name: docker-preview
rows.command:
OPENAGI_AUTH_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
docker run -d --name openagi --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:43210:43210 -v openagi-data:/data -e OPENAGI_AUTH_TOKEN="$OPENAGI_AUTH_TOKEN" ghcr.io/spshulem/openagi:v0.0.83
rows.context: Requires Docker and OpenSSL. Save the generated token; enter it at http://127.0.0.1:43210/ when the dashboard asks.
